name: keyassay
description: Assay a live TLS endpoint for quantum-vulnerable key material and certify how long harvested traffic stays unreadable.

transport.authentication: none — ownership is an anonymous HTTP-only session cookie

tools.name: assay_host
tools.description: Perform a real TLS handshake with a hostname, read its certificate chain and Certificate Transparency history, run the deterministic assay engine, persist the result and seal it.

host.description: Hostname to assay, for example example.com. No scheme, path or credentials.

label.description: Short name for this endpoint in the ledger.

notes.description: Free-text note stored with the assay.

idempotency_key.description: Retry-safe key. Replaying it returns the original assay instead of creating a second one.

tools.name: list_assays
tools.description: Return the assays owned by the current session, with grade, score, modelled break year, decision and seal.

tools.name: get_assay
tools.description: Return one assay with its observation payload, itemised factors, citations, exposure analysis and optionally its sealed audit trail.

tools.name: rerate_assay
tools.description: Recompute an assay under an overridden confidentiality horizon or qubit growth rate without changing the stored measurement.

tools.name: record_decision
tools.description: Record a migration verdict against an assay, appending a signed audit event.

tools.name: delete_assay
tools.description: Soft-delete an assay, retaining its tombstone and audit chain. Requires confirm=true.

tools.name: verify_integrity
tools.description: Recompute the SHA-384 hash chain for one assay, or every assay in the session, and report the first broken link.

tools.name: get_policy
tools.description: Read or persist the confidentiality horizon, cost anchor, qubit growth assumption and classical security floor.

tools.name: export_certificate
tools.description: Render the sealed certificate for an assay as json, html or csv.
